Lin-Manuel Miranda musical that became Broadway's defining 2010s hit at the Richard Rodgers.

How Hamilton connects

  • Topic: Broadway — Hamilton is the defining 2010s Broadway hit.
  • Location: Richard Rodgers Theatre — Hamilton's Broadway run is at the Richard Rodgers Theatre.
  • Event: Tony Awards — Hamilton swept the 2016 Tony Awards.

What is Hamilton?

Hamilton is the hip-hop Founders musical that moved from the Public Theater to the Richard Rodgers Theatre in 2015, swept the Tonys, and became the show other Broadway hits are still measured against.

Key threads lead to Broadway, Richard Rodgers Theatre and Tony Awards.
